extension.summary: Browse and play a UHD Media Server library
浏览并播放 UHD 媒体服务器资源库
extension.description: Kodi client for UHD Media Server, which speaks an Emby-compatible HTTP API. Browse libraries, resume playback, search, manage favourites and watched state. Server address and account are configured in the addon settings.
UHD 媒体服务器的 Kodi 客户端（服务端使用 Emby 兼容接口）。支持资源库浏览、继续观看、搜索、收藏与观看状态同步。服务器地址与账号在插件设置中填写。
